note: The unpriced-default-model ratchet (Task 8, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-03-budget-laboratory.md). Mirrors the shape hardening-baseline.json / packages/hardening/src/baseline.ts already use in this repo: a baseline that may only shrink. `pnpm run models:defaults:check` goes red if a default model with no `rate_for_model` branch is NOT listed here (growth), red if a listed entry now HAS a rate and the entry was not deleted (undeleted progress), and red if a listed entry no longer matches any current default model (stale cover). It is green while every unpriced default is accounted for here — the debt is enumerated, not hidden. Every entry names the vendor's OFFICIAL pricing page — never a third-party aggregator: an unverified number presented as fact is exactly the failure this task exists to prevent. Edited BY HAND: no command writes this file.
